title: Recover a safe U-VEND Manual Nos route without vendor creation
purpose: Find a safer Business Central UI route for enabling or proving U-VEND Manual Nos after list checkbox/cell routes did not persist.

smartDecision.whyNow: D2E proved the visible list route is not sufficient: DOM checkbox mapping was unavailable, exact cell discovery was too strict, and screenshot-coordinate fallback did not make U-VEND Manual Nos active after reopen.
fieldsToChange: U-VEND Manual Nos. / Manuelle Anz. only, only if a new route is proven
smartDecision.risk: Business Central list focus can drift and visible checkbox columns are not necessarily reliable write controls.
smartDecision.fallback: Stop with a blocker and keep vendor retry locked if no card/detail/personalization/Page-Inspection-backed route is found.
smartDecision.screenshotProof: Every route attempt must include screenshot QA before/after/reopen, and the image must show U-VEND, not U-SO or another row.
smartDecision.bookExplanation: The book can explain Manual Nos. as a prerequisite, but not claim the Universaarl vendor route is ready until this setup is proven.

entryCriteria: D2E result exists and is blocked without setup change.
Business Central context is playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
No vendor creation retry is attempted before Manual Nos. is proven active.
stopIf: The active instance is not playthru.
The active company is not UNIVERSAARL-DE.
U-VEND row is not uniquely visible.
The route focuses U-SO or another row.
Manual Nos. cannot be proven active after reopen.
Any dialog asks to save unrelated setup, create a record, post, preview, delete or switch company.
Playwright storageState/auth token is missing or expired. Refresh auth before retry.
acceptanceCriteria: A new route signal is used, not the D2/D2B/D2E failed routes.
Before screenshot shows U-VEND and current Manual Nos. state.
Only U-VEND Manual Nos. is changed if a safe route exists.
Reopen proof shows U-VEND Manual Nos. active, or the case blocks without setup change.
